versions.content: ReadDataByIdentifier Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of UDS service 0x22 (ReadDataByIdentifier). Rationale: The service allows for reading values on the server according to the definition of a given data identifier. This is a frequently used functionality. Use Case: The user wants to read the values associated with a given data identifier from the server. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [2].
